opening.argument: The video promotes Forsage participation by presenting entry as affordable at “one slot only Rp150,000 or $10” while associating that starting amount with “the next 150 million income.” It describes successive paid slots rising from $20 to $80, participant benefits distributed across matrix rows, and a registration path through a website and Telegram group, including an offered referral. These features establish a recruitment-based, tiered payment structure tied to crypto-linked matrices and escalating participation costs. The recording does not establish that the stated income is guaranteed or achievable, and it shows no completed payment, victim loss, or resulting payout; those limitations do not change what is being promoted: paid entry, further slots, and recruitment into the program.
